messages.content: Hey there, it's your weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope the week's been decent. Do you have a blood pressure reading to share today?
Yeah. 141 over 88. Took it twice, same both times.
Got it — 141/88, logged for today. Thanks for double-checking it, that's helpful. Anything else going on this week, or are we good?
Sounds good. I'll send your next check-in same time next week. Take care out there.
